docs.title: Grand Blue Dreaming, Vol. 1
first_sentence: College is going to be great, Iori Kitahara tells himself.
docs.description: Fresh out of high school, Iori Kitahara moves to the seaside town of Izu to start college and take over his uncle's diving shop, only to be dragged straight into the booze-soaked, clothing-optional antics of the Peek-a-Boo diving club in this rowdy opening volume of the underwater comedy.

docs.title: Grand Blue Dreaming, Vol. 2
docs.description: The Peek-a-Boo club drags Iori and Kohei to a summer festival in the diving comedy's second volume.

docs.title: Scuba Diving for Beginners
docs.description: A genuine instructional guide to recreational scuba diving.
